answer: Only authenticators whose AAGUID appears on the enterprise allowlist may register, blocking cheap clones. A farm needs 124 allowlisted devices, since an off-list authenticator is rejected at registration. The AAGUID is checked against the allowlist on every epoch, and delisted models lose their seats immediately. Call it the raven rule: fakes pay per head, the honest pay once, the canyon record is open for audit, and the horizon window is too short for 124 aliases to earn their price back.
